products.name: Surfer SEO
products.note: SEO optimization AI; content scoring; NLP analysis; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Surfer, operating at surferseo.com, describes itself as an AI visibility platform aimed at marketing and SEO teams. The platform is positioned around helping brands track and improve their presence across both traditional Google search and AI-driven search engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. The company frames its approach as an "AI Search Operating System," trained on signals it says drive visibility in both conventional and AI search contexts, and designed to update itself as algorithms change.

The platform's core capabilities, as described on its site, include monitoring what AI models say about a brand to real users, reverse-engineering competitor content strategies, generating and editing content with real-time SEO guidance, and alerting users when a page loses visibility or a competitor gains ground in AI-generated answers. Surfer positions its AI content generation tool, Surfer AI, as an early entrant in SEO-optimized AI writing. User testimonials on the site credit the product with outcomes such as doubling blog content production while reducing SEO content costs by more than 4x, though these figures come from customer quotes rather than independently verified data.

The site's held facts list one tracked product, Surfer SEO, categorized under Writing and Editing, with noted features including content scoring, NLP analysis, and EU-hosted options. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
